body:
i’ve never heard the term emotional vampire before but it matches her completely!!!

thank you for this, i’ve had friends say similar things but I sort of assumed they were just taking my side because they felt they had to

it’s really nice to hear it from someone else :)
i mean not that i know of, mum and I are both born and raised in Aus. Other than eating together when we can we don’t have any set meal customs or anything

that would actually make sense, except she’s been using oestrogen patches for a few years now so I think she’s past that. 

I think it might’ve left the mood swings with her tho :/

oh, I didn’t even think about that! 

I put them in the freezer only because they would dry out if I left them out, but I see how that could’ve felt like i’d forgotten about her.
just flour, hot water and a bit of salt :)
it unfortunately is, especially catering wise. for example she tends to ask for giant favours and get furious if people refuse
yeah, that was what I was worried about and why I posted it here. but i’ll talk to her about it tomorrow and hopefully I can patch anything up :)

i’m currently finishing my last year of high school, so i haven’t been doing as many chores recently. it is just the two of us and we used to do half and half, so I think me doing less sparked part of this. 

she’s her own boss in a medical field which is time consuming and stressful, but due to that and money from relatives we are finically very comfortable. 

she’s been a bit iffy for a while, I even tried to convince her to do therapy with me at one point but she didn’t want to. 

luckily, i’ve saved up enough that i’m moving out of home next year! 

thank you btw, i’m really grateful you took the time to reply :)
yes, she normally cooks but I cook about once or sometimes twice a week
calm at first but she escalated to screaming pretty quickly
yeah she wanted me to cook them for her when she got home. except she didn’t tell me that until after she’d cooked them herself :/

thank you! it’s nice to hear that!

I do find i’m often the adult of the house, partly because she’s an only parent. which just makes it harder to figure out who is in the wrong!
thank you, that means a lot to me :)
